risks.risk_title: Pre-interface backfill mistaken for candidate promotion
risks.mitigation: All prep artifacts mark candidate_review_prep_status as PREPARED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW, not PROMOTED
risks.control: Closeout and safety audit explicitly set candidate_promotion_executed=false
Closeout requires human decision before proceeding
risks.rollback_trigger: ready_for_candidate_review becomes non-empty without human sign-off

risks.mitigation: All validation snapshots enforce ready_for_promotion_review: maxItems 0 via schema

risks.risk_title: Family overlap not fully reviewed before candidate review
risks.mitigation: Family overlap matrix flags F26/F27 as HOLD_FOR_FAMILY_OVERLAP_REVIEW
risks.control: Overlap matrix reviewed by human before candidate review
risks.rollback_trigger: F26/F27 promoted without family overlap resolution

risks.mitigation: Decision template explicitly requires human approval per family
risks.control: Family registry requires explicit human review
risks.rollback_trigger: New family enters frozen candidates without review

risks.mitigation: All manifests enforce asof_policy.requires_known_at=true and requires_pit=true
risks.rollback_trigger: Factor enters any runtime without PIT enforcement

risks.risk_title: Coverage tier below U475 not detected before review
risks.mitigation: PIT/coverage matrix checks coverage_passed=true and coverage_tier=U475
risks.control: If coverage drops below U475, candidate review precondition fails

risks.risk_title: Single-factor validation insufficient for reliable signal
True OOS not completed before promotion decision
risks.mitigation: All guardrail profiles list true_oos_validation in not_run. Promotion blocked by not_run guardrails.

risks.risk_title: Guardrail not_run items ignored before candidate review
risks.mitigation: Guardrail matrix lists not_run items. Decision template requires guardrail review before GO decision.
risks.control: Guardrail review status must be resolved
risks.rollback_trigger: GO for candidate without not_run guardrails resolved

risks.risk_title: Turnover/cost risk for F27 not quantified before review
risks.mitigation: F27 flagged as high_turnover, cost_sensitive. Turnover guardrail not_run.
risks.control: Turnover/cost guardrail must pass before promotion

risks.risk_title: Crowding/sentiment risk for F30 not reviewed
risks.mitigation: F30 volume-based — may overlap with F11 reversal zone. Overlap matrix flags.
risks.rollback_trigger: F30 enters candidate review without overlap review

risks.risk_title: Volatility/tail risk for F31/F34 not stress-tested
risks.mitigation: F31/F34 flagged with risk_flags. Tail risk guardrail not_run.
risks.control: Tail risk and regime shift guardrails must pass before promotion

risks.risk_title: SkillOS misreads allowed_application_modes as execution permission
risks.mitigation: Application contracts enforce 7 blocked modes. invocation_request schema only allows readonly intents. execution_requested const false.
blocked_outputs includes alpha_claim. Allowed_outputs only allows research_factor_score and monitoring_state.
risks.control: Application contract schema enforces blocked_outputs contains alpha_claim

risks.risk_title: Production/broker/real_trade hard locks bypassed by downstream pipeline
risks.mitigation: All artifacts enforce production=BLOCKED, broker_runtime=BLOCKED, real_trade=BLOCKED. Schema enforces const BLOCKED.
risks.control: Safety audit checks all artifacts before each gate

risks.risk_title: Multi-factor composite executed before candidate review
Weight optimization triggered before factor freeze
